name: Turin DF64 (Gen 1)
details: The first DF64: electric single-dose grinder with 64 mm flat burrs and a stepless dial 0–90.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 0–6, espresso 3–19, moka pot 18–43, AeroPress 15–69, V60 22–47, filter coffee machine 13–64, French press 47–90, cold brew 56–90. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. For the stock burrs.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
